description: Android activity class 'MediaActivity' handling media display and playback (audio, image, video) with service binding and UI controls.

classes.name: MediaActivity
classes.description: Android activity for media playback and display, supporting audio, image, and video types with service integration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, and handles media attachment based on type.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles video attachment initialization on start if SDK >= 24.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles video attachment initialization on resume if SDK < 24 or player is null.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases video player resources if SDK < 24.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases video player resources if SDK >= 24.

methods.name: bindToMusicService
methods.description: Binds activity to music service, optionally as foreground.

methods.name: collectMusicServiceFlow
methods.description: Collects playback info from music service to update UI.

methods.name: handleAudioAttachment
methods.description: Prepares UI for audio playback, loads album art, and sets background.

methods.name: handleImageAttachment
methods.description: Displays image attachment with tap-to-hide toolbar.

methods.name: handleVideoAttachment
methods.description: Initializes video player for video attachment.
